display_name: Phase1 hierarchical source waveform prior pilot
description: Fit 12-component source-only hierarchical Gaussian prior (two waveform subclusters per six clean-F pseudo classes), compare fixed blind posterior with original six-component prior.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six clean-F pseudo classes split into 2 waveform clusters with class/global covariance shrinkage
data.tx_sets_ref: No source true TX labels, U_s truth, V or test; high-confidence clean-F pseudo classes and paired source IQ only

permissions.query_use: Only source fit clean IQ and frozen-F pseudo classes; source evaluation clean-F pseudo targets; no U_s truth, V or test
permissions.claim_scope: Source physical IDs previously observed in other views; pseudolabel agreement not independent true test accuracy; mixture may hallucinate identity

dimensions: six RX8 impaired source scenes; raw, DURA, original prior, hierarchical prior
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Fit clean source IQ grouped by clean F high-confidence pseudo class and deterministic source waveform clustering; no true TX labels or test.

rows.method: 12-component hierarchical source Gaussian prior with frozen blind channel
rows.purpose: test whether modeling within-class waveform variation preserves signal and frozen-F pseudo identity
rows.seed_notes: Frozen blind model seed 2026120454; source prior/holdout sampling 2026120355; deterministic 2-means seed 2026121654 plus class index
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: This is an exploratory finer mixture after observing six-component prior limitations; at least 64 source records per subcluster required; checkpoint/metrics reflect one seed and previously explored source IDs.
methods: frozen blind channel initial estimate followed by regularized alternating signal and channel updates
